verdict.rationale: Migration fits an invoicing product that supports recurring invoices and stored cards, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no spreadsheet or competitor import, no subscription migration tooling, and no PCI-compliant card-data transfer. A general API, PCI-DSS compliance and card storage are only building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing
